speaker: Narrator
text:
The console beeped once. Then it stopped. Mara pressed her palm to
the cold glass and listened. Nothing came back.

speaker: Narrator
text: The silence answered her. The silence had always answered her.

speaker: Narrator
text:
On the third day, the signal returned. Not a voice. A pattern. Old
radio etiquette, tapped out in the dark by someone who still believed someone
was listening.

speaker: Narrator
text:
She stared at the screen until her eyes burned. She had not told it
where she was. She had told no one.

speaker: Narrator
text:
Outside, the wind died. The station hummed its one low note.
Somewhere in the dark, something had begun to move toward the light.

speaker: Narrator
text:
The log ended there. What you heard tonight is the last
transmission from Station Seven, recovered and restored. If you found your
way here, you are not alone either.
